description_en: The two stone pillar are located a few hundred meters appart from each other. Pillar 001 is located in the locality of Pipal Sāre, in front of the Pipal Sāre School, and pillar 002 is installed on the side of a nearby small path.The dimensions of the pillars are as follow:Pillar 001: 213 x 45 x 17Pillar 002: 124 x 36 x 17Pillar 001 is oriented to the north-east. Both sides are ornamented by carvings but only the northeastern side contains an inscription. Although latter is eroded, it is possible to read the 1240 or 1242 of the Śaka era. This would date the inscription from 1318-1320. The sides of the pillar have been used by villagers to sharpen metal tools.Pillar 002 is oriented east-west. Only the western side is visible. This side is blank. It is probably the back of the pillar. The other side is not accessible as it is just next to a boulder.Stone pillars were erected throughout the Karnali Basin from the 13th to the 17th century. They are installed to honor the memory of deceased persons, mostly warriors. In this case the pillar 001 can safely be attributed to 1318-1320 CE. The period corresponds to the reign of Āditya Malla, a Khaśa Malla emperor who had then just returned from Tibet, where he stayed as a monk for some 15 years, at the Shakya monastery. In the meantime, his cousin Ripu Malla ruled over the empire (Andolfatto 2019). Pillar 002 may date from the same period, i.e. early 14th century.
description_ne: यी दुई खम्बाहरू एक-अर्काबाट केहि सय मिटरको दूरीमा छन् । पहिलो खम्बा (Pillar 001) पिपल सारे भन्ने ठाउँको पिपल सारे नामको विद्यालयको ठ्याक्कै अगाडिपट्टि छ र दोस्रो (Pillar 001) चाँहि एउटा सानो बाटोको छेवैमा छ ।पहिलो खम्बा (००१): १२३ x ४५ x १७ सेन्टिमिटर छ र दोस्रो (002): १२४ x ३६ x १७ सेन्टिमिटरको छ । पहिलो खम्बा उत्तर-पूर्वतर्फ फर्केको छ र यसमा बुट्टाहरू कुँदिएका छन् । उत्तर-पूर्वको मोहोडामा भने अभिलेख छ । अभिलेखका अक्षरहरू पढ्न सक्ने अवस्थामा छैनन् तर यसको मिति भने पढ्न सकिन्छ । मिति चाँहि शकसम्वत् १२४० अथवा १२४२ (सन् १३१८ अथवा १३२०) देखिन्छ । खम्बाको किनारा भाग गाउँलेहरूले फलामको हतिहारहरू धार लगाउन प्रयोग गर्दछन् ।दोस्रो खम्बा उत्तर-पश्चिमतर्फ फर्केको छ र पश्चिमतर्फको भागमात्रै देख्न सकिन्छ र यो खालि छ ।अभिलेख प्रमाण भएकोलो पहिलो खम्बा सन् १३१८ वा १३२० मा गाडिएको हो भन्ने प्रष्ट हुन्छ । यो समयमा खश मल्ल राज्यका आदित्य मल्ल शासक थिए जो तिब्बतमा १५ वर्षसम्म एउटा शाक्य विहारमा भिक्षुको रूपमा बसेर भर्खरै मात्र फर्केका थिए । त्यो समयमा उनका काका/ठूलो बुबाको छोरा रिपू मल्लले राजकाज सम्हालेका थिए । दोस्रो खम्बा पनि पहिलो खम्बा गाडिएको आसपासको मितिमै गाडिएको हुन सक्ने देखिन्छ ।

historical_events.event_description: The inscription is written in Devanagari script. It is eroded but it remains possible to read, on the third line from the top: [sa]ke 1240 (or 1242).This date situates the installation of the pillar in the year 1318 or 1320 CE, during the reign of the Khaśa Malla emperor Āditya Malla.
